heroSubheading: Moving from the West Midlands to London, Cornwall, Manchester, or Scotland? Enjoy guaranteed direct delivery dates with a dedicated vehicle and no intermediate depot handling.
summary: Relocating from Birmingham to London, Manchester, Scotland, Wales, or the South Coast? Our long-distance removal company provides dedicated door-to-door transit without co-loading or depot transfers. Your furniture and personal possessions travel directly in our Euro 6 ULEZ and CAZ compliant Luton removal van with live driver tracking and guaranteed delivery dates. Get a binding, transparent long-distance removal quote today with £50k transit cover included as standard.
benefits: Dedicated vehicle exclusively carrying your belongings — zero co-loading with strangers
Guaranteed delivery dates agreed in writing prior to moving day
Comprehensive Goods in Transit insurance up to £50,000 across all UK motorways
Live driver GPS communication and tracking updates throughout the journey
Experienced long-haul crews familiar with London, coastal, and rural Scottish routes

process.title: Detailed Video or Home Survey
process.description: We establish precise cubic volume, road access at both ends, and optimal delivery windows for long-distance transit.

process.title: Dedicated Loading
process.description: Our team systematically loads and blankets your entire home into dedicated Luton vehicles, locking the cargo doors for non-stop travel.

process.title: Direct Highway Transit
process.description: The van travels directly along major UK arterial routes (M1, M6, M5, M40, A1M) straight to your new destination.

process.title: Destination Placement & Assembly
process.description: Upon arrival, our crew unloads into designated rooms and rebuilds essential furniture so you can sleep in comfort on night one.

whatsIncluded: Dedicated Luton van and experienced 2-person long-haul crew
All motorway fuel, tolls (e.g. Dartford Crossing, M6 Toll where planned)
Clean Air Zone, London ULEZ, and LEZ compliance fees included
Full packing blankets, sofa ties, and floor runners
Goods in Transit insurance up to £50,000
whatsNotIncluded: Overnight ferry fares to Isle of Wight, Isle of Man, or Channel Islands unless itemised
Long-term destination storage if completion is delayed beyond agreed window
Customer flight or rail travel tickets
Customs import paperwork (Great Britain domestic only)
priceNotes: Achievable starting price for a 1-bedroom flat move from Birmingham to London (125 miles) with dedicated vehicle.

faqs.question: Do you co-load my belongings with other customers' goods on long journeys?
faqs.answer: No. We believe in dedicated point-to-point moves. Your removal van is 100% dedicated to your household, eliminating any risk of mix-ups or delayed deliveries.

faqs.question: Can you handle long-distance moves to Scotland, Wales, or Cornwall?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly undertake relocations from the West Midlands to Edinburgh, Glasgow, the Scottish Highlands, South Wales, Pembrokeshire, Devon, and Cornwall.

faqs.question: Are your vans compliant with London's Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our fleet complies with Euro 6 standards, allowing unrestricted entry into Greater London's ULEZ and Congestion Charge zones.

faqs.question: How do you handle overnight moves?
faqs.answer: For journeys exceeding 200 miles or involving multi-bedroom homes, we often load on day one, travel and stay overnight near the destination, and unload first thing on morning two.
